newsitem.title: PERU: Peru says signs $1.4 bln debt accord with France.
newsitem.headline: Peru says signs $1.4 bln debt accord with France.

text.p: Peru's Foreign Ministry said Friday the government had signed in Paris an accord with France to reschedule about $1.4 billion debt over 20 years.
The ministry said in a statement the agreement concluded Peru's negotiations with the Paris Club of creditor nations.

"With this bilateral accord, the most important due to the amount involved, the Peruvian government has successfully culminated the renegotiation carried out with the creditor countries under the agreement obtained with the Paris Club on July 20, 1996," the statement said.
It did not give more details of the accord with France.
